prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with knee injury after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 14 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1414; do not mention it.)
text:
Clinical Treatment Summary

Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which the patient's vehicle was sideswiped while changing lanes. The patient reported immediate pain and swelling in the right knee with difficulty bearing weight. Initial examination revealed effusion, tenderness along the medial joint line, and limited range of motion. Imaging was obtained to rule out fracture, and findings were consistent with a soft tissue injury without acute osseous abnormality. A diagnosis of medial collateral ligament sprain with associated knee contusion was established.

Conservative management was initiated, including activity modification, ice, compression, a hinged knee brace for ambulation, and a structured physical therapy program focused on quadriceps strengthening, gait training, and progressive range-of-motion exercises. The patient attended a total of 14 treatment visits over the course of care. Pain and swelling improved steadily, and by the final visit the patient was ambulating without assistive devices with near-full range of motion and only mild residual discomfort with prolonged standing. The prognosis is good, with a recommendation for a home exercise program and follow-up as needed.
